title: BCD Chemie GmbH
content:
BCD Chemie is a Hamburg-based specialty chemicals distributor with strong application-support capabilities. The company distributes aerogel materials for advanced coatings and other technically demanding European markets.

  • Coverage Area: Germany and wider Europe
  • Focus Areas: Silica aerogel particles for coatings, matting, specialty formulations, thermal insulation, and hydrophobic additive applications
  • Current Brands Represented: Cabot Corporation (Enova® Aerogel)
  • Official Website: https://www.bcd-chemie.de/en/product-ranges/aerogel/
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
